brief: Concrete stave silo about 18 ft across and 50 ft high standing just behind the big red dairy barn: weathered buff-grey staves with dark joint lines, the top ring of staves left white to make a crisp checkered band under the open rim, and a tall round galvanized steel unloader chute tube running up the side. Corrugated steel grain bins with conical roofs cluster at its foot, a steel windmill beside it, pasture with grazing black cattle in front.
